rules.levels: legacy rows unchanged; a non-variant creature sells the same level ladder as its legacy species (else the modal ladder of its tier); a variant (Aberrant/X/R/Tek) sells one row at the top level of its legacy base species; Tek spawn level = ceil(level/1.2)
rules.prices: legacy prices unchanged; variants = legacy base species price at that level x median variant ratio learned from legacy pairs; species without legacy anchor = explicit priceAs legacy species, else tier table (median legacy price of the tier members selling exactly the tier ladder); a variant without a legacy base takes the tier price without multiplier; computed prices rounded to 5 (10 when >= 200), legacy prices copied 1:1 are not re-rounded; minimum 10 IC
rules.aquatic: water-only creatures get "ต้องอยู่ในน้ำตอนรับ" (they spawn where the buyer stands)
rules.dedupe: one sellable product per blueprint + displayed level; a draft whose blueprint is already sold by a legacy row stays inactive
